## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich bin voll im Flow** — [ish bin foll im floh] — *I'm completely in the zone*
2. **Das regt mich zum Nachdenken an** — [das raykt mish tsoom NAHKH-den-ken an] — *That makes me think / gives me food for thought*
3. **Lass es auf dich wirken** — [lass es owf dish VEER-ken] — *Let it sink in / let it work on you*
